section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study conducted over two consecutive days. On Day 1, participants received training on basic software and task procedures, including target classification and engage decisions, and initial individual difference measures like performance orientation were collected. Day 2 focused on advanced task components such as cue ambiguity and penalty circles, which participants practiced through 15 scenarios of varying complexity before completing a more difficult 12-minute transfer task.
